svg.text: GROOVE — SEEK (accent: position is playback truth)
GROOVE — VOLUME (no accent: a setting, not the music)
the unity detent sits above the travel, clear of the knob — faint at rest, full paper when the handle is on it
QUIET READOUTS — never the accent, never an icon
album gain, from the file's own tags
said once, in the counts line
EMPTY & LOADING — quiet text, never an illustration
The shelf fills as the scan finds your music…
Play an album and it appears here
Nothing on this sheet animates. iced 0.13 has no animation runtime, and a frame subscription to fake one would cost the idle-cost promise.
